art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Gangplank is a rugged adult pirate captain with a thick dark beard, weathered face, broad hat, long red-brown coat, and recognizable mechanical arm details. Preserve his fully closed shirt, opaque trousers, heavy boots, and layered belts. His curved cutlass remains sheathed and his pistol sits in a closed holster, with no aiming, smoke, or active weapon handling.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: weathered red, navy sea, leather brown, brass gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
